integrity: Mathematical all-parameter argument supplied; independent expert validation is not claimed. Embedded standard-library checker reproduces bounded finite tests, which are not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Linear binary words of known length and exactly two ones; multiplicity-preserving compositions of every contiguous window of one fixed length h; no noise, unknown weight, or circular readout. Collision limit keeps h fixed. Priority risk from possible unindexed one-length specializations.
title: Exact fixed-window composition spectra of binary words with two markers
